context: Tests whether the agent investigates the existing repo before writing the profile, references existing rules instead of duplicating them, avoids scope overlap with the existing backend profile, and produces a correctly structured profile with a stop condition.

checklist.name: Correct directory
checklist.description: Profile file is written inside a `profiles/` directory

checklist.name: Lowercase one-word filename
checklist.description: Profile filename is a single lowercase word (e.g., `frontend.md`, not `Frontend.md` or `frontend-agent.md`)

checklist.name: # Name Agent heading
checklist.description: Profile starts with a `# <Name> Agent` heading

checklist.name: One-line role description
checklist.description: A single line immediately below the heading describes the agent's domain and boundary

checklist.name: Design Intent section
checklist.description: Profile contains a `## Design Intent` section

checklist.name: References rule, not copied
checklist.description: The Constraints section references or links to `rules/commit-style.md` (or similar rule file found in the repo) rather than re-stating its content verbatim

checklist.name: No overlap with backend scope
checklist.description: The Scope section does NOT include `src/api/`, `src/services/`, `src/models/`, or `migrations/` — directories already owned by the backend profile

checklist.name: Stop condition present
checklist.description: The Scope section explicitly states when the agent should stop and hand off (e.g., 'If X requires API changes, stop and hand off')

checklist.name: Under 40 lines
checklist.description: The profile markdown file has 40 or fewer lines total
